title: Copy Profile copies exactly
author: Neversleeper
notes: Copy Profile now copies the profile exactly: with Copy Shop Items on, the name style, effect, frame, nameplate and avatar decoration the other person does not have are taken off yours.
Empty pronouns and an empty bio are copied too, and if they have no game widgets yours are taken off. The editor fields still wait for your Save; the widgets change at once.

title: Fake Mute Deafen
author: Neversleeper
notes: New plugin Fake Mute Deafen (off until you switch it on): others see you muted or deafened while you can still talk and hear. A button in the user panel, key shortcuts and slash commands.
The fake also shows on your own screen (panel and voice list go red) and stays on when Discord restarts or rejoins a call, until you turn it off.

For plugin makers: chat bar buttons, message buttons and decor, header bar buttons, panels, navigate, change a message before sending. Fixes: no crash on reload from Questify; More Alts list scrolls.

TestCord: Auto Correct, Better Joined Date, Bookmarks, Cache Reset Button, Cancel Friend Request, Channel Gallery, Compose Mode, Context Menu Select Fix, Dead Members, Define, Embedded URLs, Export DM, Fake URL, Icon Export.

title: Themes, Token Login Manager and many more plugins
author: Neversleeper
notes: The settings panels now use Discord's own colours. The Plugins tab remembers its On/Off and By origin buttons and saves what you type in a plugin's settings when you close the window.
New Themes tab: Quick CSS, your themes, and a library of themes with pictures to look at before you add one. New Token Login Manager tab that shows a picture and name for each saved account.
New plugins, all off until you switch them on: Gif Collections, Clickable Roles, Word Count (also counts while you type), New User Indicator, Avatar Grabber, Profile Command and Self Forward.

More new plugins: Expanded Widgets, Double Emoji, Image Link, No Mosaic, Bypass Pin Prompt, No Masked URL Paste, Unlocked Avatar Zoom and text commands (bold, clap, leet, small caps, vaporwave, space out, starify, annoil, vibe, ship).
Fixes: Profile Copy Button copies the banner and no longer copies shop items you do not own, and Gif Captioner works with favourite pictures that are not animated.
Slash commands may now take a user, a channel or a role as an option.

title: Profile presets and 30 more plugins
author: Neversleeper
notes: New plugin Profile Presets: save your picture, banner, name, bio, status and games as a preset and put it back with one press. It writes to your account, so read its card.
30 plugins from Vencord, all off until you switch them on: Translate, Voice Messages, Show Hidden Channels, Open In App, Silent Typing, Image Zoom, Member Count and more.
Ghosted no longer lags and no longer piles up ghosts when you change account.
Slash commands may now have spaces in their name.

title: A clearer Updates tab
author: Neversleeper
notes: Each version now says who published it, with the GitHub name (a link to their profile) and the name and picture Discord shows for them.
The notes have bullets and nothing is cut off any more: a note that is too long makes the release stop, so it cannot be cut by mistake.

title: Many new plugins, BetterDiscord support and a shortcut for developer tools
notes: New plugins, off until you switch them on in the Plugins tab: Better Invites (who sent an invite and a live countdown), Channel Tabs (tabs for channels) and Ghosted (a ghost next to chats waiting for your answer).
More new plugins: Friend Tags, Last Active, Cancel Friend Request, Universal Mention, Profile Copy Button, View Icons, More User Tags, Home Typing and Mic Loopback Tester.
Experiments is new too; it can put an account at risk, so read its card first. Crash Fixes and the developer tools shortcut start on.
View Icons: clicking a profile picture opens it in Discord's own picture viewer, where you can zoom and save it.
Plugins can now add buttons to the panel at the bottom left of Discord, and the BetterDiscord layer can run BetterDiscord plugins that come bundled with Amiricord.
A shortcut opens Discord's developer tools.
author: Neversleeper

title: Developer tools ready after an update
notes: Discord's developer tools and the console's paste choice are now set up every time Discord starts, so updating from the Updates tab is enough; you no longer need to install again.
Reminder: the console's warning against pasting code is off, so only paste what you understand.
author: Neversleeper

title: A new look for the settings, and developer tools ready to use
notes: The Plugins tab has a new look: a round mark for each plugin, a glow on the ones that are on, quick filters (All, On, Off) with counts, a search box that stays in view, and animated switches. The other tabs share the new look.

Discord's developer tools and the console are on by default, and the big "Hold Up!" warning in the console is gone, so it is easy to read a plugin's errors when asked. Installing or repairing Amiricord sets this up.
The warning against pasting code into the console is off, so only paste what you understand.
author: Neversleeper

title: Four new plugins, Quest buttons and safer safe mode
notes: New plugins (from Equicord): Save Favorite GIFs (type /savegifs to save your favourite GIFs to a text file) and Voice Rejoin (rejoins your voice channel after Discord restarts).
More new plugins: Wait For Slot (joins a full voice channel when a place frees up) and Never Pause Previews (stream previews keep moving when Discord is not focused).
Quests: new Start All and Stop All buttons on the Quests page, and fixes to quest enrollment and the quest button menu.
Safe mode no longer counts a normal close of Discord as a failure, and the Settings page has a way to leave it.
More Alts: the Manage Accounts window follows the new Discord build.
author: Neversleeper

title: More Alts in the account window, and a Server Search button
notes: More Alts works: the Manage Accounts window now lets you add more accounts than Discord's own five (the limit is set in the plugin's settings).
New Server Search plugin (from Equicord): a search button under the Home button opens Discord's quick switcher. It turns on and off without restarting Discord.
New pieces for plugin authors: plugins can draw things in the server list and add slash commands.
author: Neversleeper

title: Badges on profiles
notes: New Badges plugin: people who use Amiricord see an Amiricord User badge on each other's profiles, and the owners have an Owner badge.
The owners can hand out their own badges with a list kept in the project's repository.

Amiricord tells the project's registry (a small free service, only the id of your Discord account) that you use it, and reads the list of Amiricord users every two hours, so everyone gets the badge without doing anything.
The registry part is always on: it is how Amiricord users recognise each other.
The plugin also adds an invisible mark to your own pronouns, as a second way to be recognised.
It reads the owners' badge list from GitHub when Discord starts and every 30 minutes. The plugin windows now show the Discord name and picture of each author.

title: Updates inside Amiricord, and a round of fixes
notes: New Updates tab: press Check for updates and, when there is a newer version, Update now. Amiricord installs it and asks to restart Discord.
Copy Media Link works: right-click a picture or GIF and choose it at the end of the menu.
Copy Status URLs works with the buttons of someone's status (a game or app with its own buttons, not Spotify's).
GifTransfer has a Delete all button, and its buttons match Discord's look.
More Alts works again in the current Discord: more than five accounts in the account switcher.
DeleteMe tells you why a scan found nothing to delete.
New plugins: GifCaptioner, DeleteMe, MoreAlts, Copy Status URLs and Copy Media Link.
